content: Zidovudine is available in the following formulations: 1. RETROVIR Tablets (300 mg): These are biconvex, white, round, film-coated tablets containing 300 mg of zidovudine. One side of the tablet is engraved with GX CW3, and the other side is marked with 300. They are supplied in bottles containing 60 tablets (NDC 49702-214-18). The tablets should be stored at a temperature range of 15°C to 25°C (59°F to 77°F). 2. RETROVIR Capsules (100 mg): These capsules are white and opaque, with a cap and body containing 100 mg of zidovudine. The cap is printed with Wellcome and a unicorn logo, while the body is marked with Y9C and 100. They are supplied in bottles containing 100 capsules (NDC 49702-211-20). The capsules should be stored at a temperature range of 15°C to 25°C (59°F to 77°F) and must be protected from moisture. 3. RETROVIR Syrup: This is a colorless to pale yellow, strawberry-flavored liquid formulation containing 10 mg of zidovudine per milliliter. It is supplied in bottles with a child-resistant cap, each containing 240 mL of syrup (NDC 49702-212-48). The syrup should be stored at a temperature range of 15°C to 25°C (59°F to 77°F).
